claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won the 2026 Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay for One Battle After Another (Warner Bros.).
One Battle After Another (Warner Bros.) is a loose adaptation of Thomas Pynchon’s 1990 novel Vineland.
Paul Thomas Anderson's first Academy Award win was the 2026 Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay.
One Battle After Another won Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson won the 2026 BAFTA Film Award for Best Adapted Screenplay for One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another was written by Paul Thomas Anderson.
Bugonia was nominated for the 2026 Best Adapted Screenplay Oscar.
Bugonia's screenplay was by Will Tracy.
Frankenstein was nominated for the 2026 Best Adapted Screenplay Oscar.
Frankenstein was written for the screen by Guillermo del Toro.
Hamnet was nominated for the 2026 Best Adapted Screenplay Oscar.
Hamnet's screenplay was by Chloé Zhao & Maggie O'Farrell.
Train Dreams was nominated for the 2026 Best Adapted Screenplay Oscar.
Train Dreams's screenplay was by Clint Bentley & Greg Kwedar
